hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Openhole packer (sleeve systems)
function: The packers between frac sleeves in an uncemented lateral that isolate each stage of bare hole so the sleeve in between treats only its interval.

tabs.overview: One packer between each pair of sleeves and one at the toe. Swellable elements expand in the well fluid; mechanical packers set hydraulically. The simulator draws them along the lateral when the openhole option is chosen in Pad Setup.
tabs.engineering: Differential rating for the frac pressure; element length for the hole rugosity; swell time before the first stage.
tabs.safety: A packer that has not set lets a stage frac the neighbor.
tabs.evidence: Completion codes article (S34), ball injector patent (S35), API 11D1 for packers (S21), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
